# pidginhost_catalog (Data Source)

Account and catalog listings as JSON strings, for configurations written for provider 0.1.x. Decode them with jsondecode.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Deprecated: kept for configurations written for provider 0.1.x. Prefer the
# typed data sources, such as pidginhost_images and pidginhost_packages.
data "pidginhost_catalog" "current" {}

output "image_slugs" {
  value = [for image in jsondecode(data.pidginhost_catalog.current.images_json) : image.slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `firewalls_json` (String) JSON array of the firewall rule sets in the account.
- `images_json` (String) JSON array of the available server images.
- `ips_json` (String) JSON array of the public IPv4 addresses in the account.
- `packages_json` (String) JSON array of the available server packages.
- `profile_json` (String, Sensitive) JSON object with the account profile (name, phone number and funds). Sensitive, since it holds personal data.
- `public_interfaces_json` (String) JSON array with the public interface and firewall settings of every server that has a public address, each entry tagged with the server_id and hostname of its server.
- `servers_json` (String) JSON array of the servers in the account.
- `ssh_keys_json` (String) JSON array of the SSH keys stored on the account.
- `volume_products_json` (String) JSON array of the available storage products (volume tiers).
- `volumes_json` (String) JSON array of the volumes in the account.
